# Quarto Wizard

[Browse, install and manage Quarto extensions, templates and brands without leaving your editor.]{.landing-lead}

::::: {.landing-actions}

[Install for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=mcanouil.quarto-wizard){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg data-landing-tab="VS Code"}
[Install for Positron](https://open-vsx.org/extension/mcanouil/quarto-wizard){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg data-landing-tab="Positron"}

::::: {.panel-tabset .landing-install group="editor"}

## VS Code

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
code --install-extension mcanouil.quarto-wizard
```

## Positron

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
positron --install-extension mcanouil.quarto-wizard
```

## Find and install in a few clicks

Pick from hundreds of extensions in the [Quarto Extensions](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-extensions/) registry.
Quarto Wizard downloads each one into `_extensions/`.

::::: {.landing-legend}

1. Filter as you type.
   [Search by name, author, type or description.]{.landing-detail}
2. Check before you install.
   [Each row shows the type, the stars and the repository.]{.landing-detail}
3. Pick several at once.
   [Tick the boxes, then confirm.]{.landing-detail}

## Keep every project current

The Quarto Wizard view lists the extensions in each workspace folder and shows the ones with a newer release.

::::: {.landing-legend}

1. See updates at a glance.
   [The latest version shows next to the one you have.]{.landing-detail}
2. Act from the row.
   [Update, remove or open the source in one click.]{.landing-detail}
3. Use extension snippets.
   [Insert the snippets that an extension ships.]{.landing-detail}
4. Work across folders.
   [Install, use a template or clean up each folder.]{.landing-detail}
